question:
Identify the figure from among the given options which when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d039233faf4fcc1d40dbe3535eaefa49b3de75ab6d256b2393ced94bfcfc90c.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) One shaded circle is eliminated from the bottom from each box subsequently.

2) One shaded circle is replaced alternately by letters X and P subsequently.
